defect_summary: Historical Poetry lock records directory sources for PyXB 1.2.5 (vendored/pyxb) and authorizenet 1.1.4 (vendored/authorizenet). The D7 R3 canon and closure derivation flatten these to name==version, and the artifact resolver selects a wheel by normalized distribution name/version, substituting a registry wheel that is NOT source-identical to the historical vendored dependency. The vendored PyXB uses collections.abc.MutableSequence; the substituted registry PyXB 1.2.5 wheel uses collections.MutableSequence and fails on Python 3.12.
p2p_note: Both exposed tasks vend the same bytes: their source trees hash identically, so one source-aware artifact identity covers both directory packages under the same generic rule.

artifact_resolution.matches: wheels by (name, version) parsed from the wheel filename only
